newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural split to reduce share volatility.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural split to reduce share volatility.

text.p: Spain's Gas Natural said on Wednesday the recently approved share split and free capital increase would lead to better liquidity and lower volatility for its shares.

At its annual meeting, shareholders approved a reduction in the nominal share value to 150 pesetas from 600 pesetas, while simultaneously agreeing to a free capital increase of 52 billion pesetas that will bring the nominal value to 500 pesetas.
"(The capital operation aims) to improve the liquidity and to reduce the volatility of our shares in the Bourse," said Gas Natural's chairman Pere Duran.
The total number of shares will rise to 149 million from 37.3 million shares, while reserves will fall to 250 billion pesetas from 302 billion pesetas.
Shareholders funds will rise to 74.63 billion pesetas from 22.39 billion pesetas and the free capital increase will be charged to reserves.
After the split the number of shares will rise to 149,258,670 from 37,314,669.
